note: Marketing assets are written from manufacturer-published facts only. No hands-on testing is claimed, no superlative is asserted as fact, and no Amazon price, rating or review count is used. Any claim that would need first-hand experience is deliberately absent.

positioning.why_this_niche: All three supplied links resolve to air fryers / air fryer toaster ovens, so the niche is dictated by the product set, not chosen by preference. Air fryers sit in a category Amazon publishes official rates for (S3: Kitchen 4.50%, Home 3.00%, fallback 4.00%), which is the only rate information that can be used legitimately.
positioning.audience: Households of 2–6 people comparing a compact dual-basket air fryer, a large single-basket air fryer, and a multi-function countertop oven.
positioning.search_intent: Commercial investigation — the buyer already knows they want an air fryer and is choosing a form factor and a size.
positioning.differentiator: Every specification on the site is traceable to a manufacturer page or owner's manual, and every gap is admitted rather than filled. That is the trust asset; it is also what keeps the site inside Program Policies §2(b) and §3(t).

seo_rules: Title pattern: '{Primary subject} — verified specs, pricing and buying advice | Zone1 Kitchen'. Title tags stay under 60 characters where possible.
One H1 per page, matching the search intent, followed by descriptive H2s drawn from the outline above.
Every factual paragraph carries an inline source marker that links to the official page or PDF.
No page claims testing, ownership, or use of a product. Where a claim would need experience, the page says so and stops.
No Amazon price, availability, star rating or review count appears in metadata, structured text or copy.
Structured data is limited to BreadcrumbList and Article — no Product/Offer schema, because that would assert price and availability facts the site is not permitted to publish.

articles_briefs.title: Dual-basket vs oven-style air fryers: the capacity question
articles_briefs.angle: Two 6 qt-class baskets vs one 26 qt cavity changes what you can cook at once, not just how much. Uses only published capacities (S10, S12, S14).

articles_briefs.title: What '450 °F' actually means on an air fryer box
articles_briefs.angle: The Chefman 8 Qt listing advertises 450 °F Hi-Fry while its own manual documents 200–400 °F. Teaches readers to check the manual for whether the top temperature is a whole cycle or a finish mode. No claim is made about which is correct.
